text:
Today space is fabulous!

Without bit, spurs, or bridle,

Let us depart on the back of wine

To a divine and magical sky!


Like two angels tortured

By implacable fever,

In the morning crystal

Let us follow the mirage.


Rocking on the wing

Of the intelligent whirlwind

In a shared delirium,


Sister, who swims beside me,

We will flee without rest

To the paradise of my dreams.

translation.title: The Wine of Lovers
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the intoxicated flight of the lovers through wine, mirage, and shared delirium.
